data.name: Index_Desc1
data.value: Used to manage human resources in manufacturing factories and ensure that workers on the production line are effectively assigned and arranged.

data.name: Index_Desc2
data.value: This system typically includes the following features:

data.name: Index_Feature1
data.value: 1. Personnel Data Management: Record employee basic information, skills, and experience.

data.name: Index_Feature2
data.value: 2. Production Scheduling: Assign employees to appropriate workstations based on production plans and line requirements, ensuring adequate staffing at each station.

data.name: Index_Feature3
data.value: 3. Work Progress Tracking: Track employee work progress and product flow on the production line, adjusting assignments promptly to address any issues.

data.name: Index_Feature4
data.value: 4. Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze employee performance and production line efficiency, providing reports and data to help management make better decisions.

data.name: Index_Feature5
data.value: 5. Safety and Monitoring: Monitor the working environment and employee safety on the production line to ensure all operations comply with safety standards.

data.name: Index_Summary
data.value: Using the production line dispatch system can improve efficiency and product quality on the production line, while reducing errors and work delays during the production process.

data.name: Index_SOP1
data.value: Standard operating procedure documents compiled and managed on a digital platform. These documents describe in detail the process of how to perform tasks to ensure consistency and efficiency.

data.name: Index_SOP2
data.value: Unified Standards: Ensure all employees follow the same operational standards, reducing errors and rework.

data.name: Index_SOP3
data.value: Simplified Training: New employees can self-learn through online SOP, accelerating onboarding speed.

data.name: Index_SOP4
data.value: Consistency: Ensure consistency in the operation process, improving work quality and result consistency.

data.name: Index_SOP5
data.value: Continuous Improvement: Continuously improve business processes and operational standards through real-time updates and feedback mechanisms.

data.name: Index_SOP6
data.value: Reduced Paper and Printing Costs: Digital documents reduce the need for physical storage and printing.

data.name: Index_SOP7
data.value: Time Saving: Improve work efficiency and reduce time waste caused by unclear processes or errors.

data.name: Index_SOP8
data.value: Real-time Updates and Review: Ensure SOP is consistent with the latest laws, regulations, and company policies, reducing compliance risks.

data.name: Index_SOP9
data.value: Clear Operating Procedures: All employees can easily access operating procedures and understand company processes and requirements.
